subject: Clarify invoice send path & VAT tagging for multi-entity billing
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Eve Robinson <eve.robinson@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify invoice send path & VAT tagging for multi-entity billing

Hi Eve —

Quick note before we finalize onboarding: we want to confirm how Acme prefers to receive invoices for the three legal entities you mentioned (US, UK, DE). Two pieces we need to lock down: 1) primary delivery channel (portal push vs. emailed PDF/XML) and 2) VAT tagging / reverse-charge evidence for UK/DE.

Proposal from our side:
- Primary: portal push (SFTP/Webhook) for the consolidated monthly statement for the US entity.
- Secondary: for UK/DE entities, we can send an XML invoice with VAT fields populated and attach a short VAT evidence checklist PDF.

If portal is not an option for any of the entities, we will fall back to signed PDF via secured email with SFTP as a backup. We can also include an XML payload in the email for your AP system.

Attachments: I attached a sample XML payload and our VAT evidence checklist to show the fields we populate. Can you confirm:
1) Which delivery channel each entity will accept (portal, SFTP, or email)?
2) For the UK/DE entities, does Acme require our VAT proof to be attached as a separate document or embedded in the XML?
3) Who should be the billing contact for each entity (name + email)?

Thanks — if you reply with the matrix we’ll finalize the invoice configuration on our side and share a one-page cookbook for your AP team.

Best,
Karthik
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-invoice-sample.xml (XML), vat-evidence-checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Eve Robinson <eve.robinson@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify invoice send path & VAT tagging for multi-entity billing

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the clear proposal. Quick answers below:

1) Delivery channel by entity:
- Acme US (Acme Corp Inc): email PDF to ap@acme-corp.com with PO# in subject is preferred.
- Acme UK (Acme UK Ltd): portal push preferred, but we can accept XML via SFTP as fallback.
- Acme DE (Acme GmbH): portal push required for invoicing reconciliation.

2) VAT evidence: For UK/DE we need a separate PDF attachment that shows the VAT registration and reverse-charge statement (not embedded in XML).

3) Billing contacts:
- US: AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com> (primary)
- UK: Sarah Milton <sarah.milton@acme-uk.com>
- DE: Tobias Klein <tobias.klein@acme-de.com>

A couple of additional notes:
- PO handling: please put the customer PO number in the top-level Invoice XML <BuyerPO> field and include it in the email subject if you email.
- Invoice frequency: monthly consolidated invoice per legal entity is ideal.

If you can update the sample XML to include a separate VATEvidence.pdf reference, we can confirm with the portal team and send the required credentials for SFTP where needed.

Best,
Eve Robinson
Head of AP Ops, Acme Corp

Kimberly / Karthik — quick confirmation from infra/billing side:

1) XML: yes, our invoice XML supports an <AttachmentReference> element that can point at a named file (e.g., VATEvidence.pdf). We will include a checksum and a URL token when pushing via portal or SFTP.
2) Portal attachments: portal push supports attaching a PDF blob to each invoice record. That meets Acme UK's "separate PDF" requirement.
3) Email flow for US: we have an email template that inserts PO# into the subject. We also attach the machine-readable XML as .xml and include a human PDF.

Next steps I recommend:
- Karthik: send Eve an updated sample XML where <BuyerPO> is populated and <AttachmentReference> shows VATEvidence.pdf for UK/DE.
- Kimberly: add the three billing contacts to our billing config and mark delivery preferences (US=email, UK=portal,SFTP fallback, DE=portal).
- I will prepare SFTP credential instructions and a short portal push cookbook (links included).

I attached an internal snippet of the XML schema (redwood-invoice-sample.xml) and the checklist you already have. Once Acme confirms we’ll provision SFTP creds for UK only (DE will get portal access).

Connor Obrien
Billing Systems Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-invoice-sample.xml (XML snippet)
